task.title: Filter the All settings list
task.shortdesc: Filter by configured, available, Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, invalid, deprecated, raw, or unknown state.

prereq.p: Open All settings with a visible settings list.

context.p: State filters narrow a large inventory by the decision the user needs to make. They are different from source filters, which explain where a value came from.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose the state filter that matches the task: configured, available, Guided-covered, All-Settings-only, invalid, deprecated, raw, or unknown.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Inspect the filtered count and representative rows.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Clear the state filter before applying unrelated edits.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The list shows settings with the selected state only.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a row is missing, clear state filters and search by exact policy or preference identifier.
